text: Sorensen looks up from the feed table as the gate swings open.
Your first days aren't in your file. Somebody in your outfit is careful with you.
You came in by the maintenance code, not my hatch. You're the one the Architect writes about.
One bin is Derek Lawson's file, and it isn't Derek's handwriting on it. It's the only place anyone wrote down why he did what he did.
The other's the Social Fabric letters. Last one's about a union rep in Butte they're about to bury. One of them's ash in a minute.
Of course. He'd want to be read.
She tips the other bin into the feed without looking at it.
